# AMU-PIE Platform

> > Adam Mickiewicz University's Platform for International Education (AMU-PIE) offering diverse courses across law, political science, education, languages, biology, and environmental studies for international and exchange students.

AMU-PIE serves as the international course catalog for Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań, Poland, featuring English-taught courses across multiple faculties including Law and Administration, Educational Studies, Political Science and Journalism, and Biology. The platform supports EPICUR alliance programs and Erasmus+ exchanges with courses addressing global citizenship, sustainable development, and critical pedagogy.

## Key Topics

- Adam Mickiewicz University
- international education
- global citizenship
- European Union law and policy
- educational inequality
- sustainable development
- critical pedagogy
- language learning
- research methodology
- neoliberalism and globalization
- environmental conservation
- political science
- employment and criminal law
- EPICUR alliance
- Erasmus+ programs

## Law and Legal Studies

- [Alternative Dispute Resolutions In Criminal Law](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1524/details): Criminal law course on restorative justice by Piotr Karlik
- [European Constitutionalism And Fundamental Rights](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1693/details): EU constitutional law & fundamental rights Erasmus course
- [Introduction To Employment Law](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1921/details): Employment law course covering EU & Polish labour regulations
- [Introduction To International Criminal Law And Procedure](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1932/details): International criminal law course on war crimes & tribunals

## Political Science and International Relations

- [Designing Political Science Research](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1378/details): Political science research methodology course by Joanna Rak at AMU
- [Common Foreign and Security Policy: Northern and Eastern Dimensions of the European Union](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1911/details): EU foreign policy course on Northern & Eastern Partnership dimensions
- [The Future Of Cities](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1941/details): Urban planning course on sustainable cities & metropolitan governance

## Education and Pedagogy

- [Globalisation, International Agencies, Economy And Education](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1468/details): Education policy course examining globalization & international agencies
- [Sociology Of Education](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1781/details): Educational sociology course examining inequality & hidden curriculum
- [Globalisation, International Agencies, Economy And Education](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1939/details): Educational policy course on globalization & international agencies

## Biology and Environmental Sciences

- [Lake Restoration - Aims, Methods, Results](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1383/details): Aquatic ecology course on lake restoration methods by Faculty of Biology
- [Humans and the Environment](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1608/details): Environmental history course on human-environment relations at AMU
- [Models of Mathematical Biology](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1612/details): Mathematical biology course covering population dynamics & epidemiology
- [Conservation genetics](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1925/details): Population genetics course on genetic variation & species conservation

## Language Courses

- [Italian for True Beginners Step 2](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1548/details): Beginner Italian language course at Foreign Languages Teaching Centre
- [Business English With Elements Of Legal English](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1629/details): B1-level business & legal English course at Foreign Languages Centre
- [Czech Language for Beginners](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1854/details): A1-level Czech language course via EPICUR online program
- [English grammar for EFL teachers](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1883/details): Advanced English grammar course for EFL teacher training (B2-C1)

## Humanities and Sciences

- [Latin in European Culture](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1643/details): Classical philology course on Latin's role in European culture
- [Introduction to Optics](https://amupie.amu.edu.pl/1698/details): Physics course on wave optics, interference & holography
